name: Laser Eye (Quistis)
doc: Laser Eye (Quistis' Blue Magic; Counter Laser-Eye's library relocated; the act family, Drain's master): once its children are gone the actor pools and the stage light ramp up, then one emitter per action - the actor system, the caster task (her cast animation bound, the sound, two laser beams from her eyes to the target with their sparks), the master's release, the damage; after the last action a wait, the light ramp down. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag071_laser_eye_quistis.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the stage in task; after the last action its wait, the stage out task; the actor counters cleared every tick

pools.doc: the caster task and the laser beams (the port's)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: the actor system, the caster task, the master's release, the damage; the master's wait and the stage light

parts.title: Caster
parts.doc: The caster's cast animation bound, its sound, the two lasers

parts.title: Laser
parts.doc: A beam from one of the caster's eyes to its target

groups.label: Actor system
groups.doc: At the emitter's start: Start, Length (ticks), Mode (0: the targets' positions)

groups.label: Stage light
groups.doc: Its ramps up (before the first action) and down (after the wait): Level, Step a tick

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage of the action's target from this tick

params.label: Wait
params.doc: After the last action, the light ramp down after these ticks

params.label: Lasers tick
params.doc: The two beams from this tick

params.label: Grow
params.doc: Its width up by this a tick (4096: full)

params.label: Hold until
params.doc: Held at the eye until this tick

params.label: Shrink
params.doc: At the target, its width down by this a tick

params.label: Flipbook 158FF60
params.doc: The sprite sequence at 0x158FF60 (a flipbook of 7 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): the actor system, the caster task, the master's release, the damage.
The stage light ramp up (the port's task: the four stage light words up a step a tick).
The stage light ramp down (the port's task: from its level down a step a tick to 0).
